AR.name: Arkansas

notice.text: Call at least 2 and not more than 10 full working days before digging.

start.text: Call no more than 10 working days before work starts.

life.text: A notice is good for 20 working days from the day it was given.

AR.renew: Not done in 20 working days, or marks gone: give a new notice.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

AR.note: The law text we read is current to March 2024. We could not confirm Arkansas’s tolerance. Check Arkansas 811.

LA.name: Louisiana

notice.text: Call at least 48 hours and not more than 120 hours ahead, not counting weekends and holidays. The 48 hours start at 7 AM the next working day.

life.text: Marks are good while visible, but not more than 20 calendar days from the mark-by time. The app counts from the call-in day, so its date can be a little early.

LA.renew: Not done in 20 days, or marks gone: give a new notice.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

LA.note: We could not confirm Louisiana’s tolerance. Check Louisiana 811.

MO.name: Missouri

notice.text: Call at least 2 and not more than 10 working days before digging.

start.text: Not started within 10 working days: ask for a relocate.

life.text: A notice is good until 11:59 PM, 21 calendar days from the start date (law of Aug 28, 2025). The app counts from the first legal dig day.

MO.renew: Not started within 10 working days: ask for a relocate first. The law does not say how to go on past 21 days: ask Missouri 811.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

sources.what: 2025 SB 133, section 319.025 (21-day life, in force Aug 28, 2025)

SD.name: South Dakota

notice.text: Give notice at least 48 hours ahead. The 48 hours start 12:01 AM the next day and skip weekends and state holidays (2026 law).

life.text: Marks are good while clearly visible, but not more than 21 calendar days from the start date on the ticket. The app counts from the first legal dig day.

SD.renew: A ticket can’t be updated more than 90 days after its first start date.
SD.tol_text: Marks within 18 inches of the facility; keep 18 inches between marks and machine teeth.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

sources.what: ARSD 20:25:03:05.01 (marks valid 21 days; the One Call Board’s copy)

WV.name: West Virginia

notice.text: Give notice at least 48 hours (not weekends or holidays) and not more than 10 work days before digging.

start.text: Give notice no more than 10 work days before work starts.

life.text: A ticket is good for no more than 15 business days.

WV.renew: Extend the ticket at least 48 hours before it expires.
WV.emergency: A break or leak that causes an emergency: call 911 right away.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

sources.what: WV811 2026 slides (15 business days; extend 48 hours before)

MS.name: Mississippi

life.text: Normal and emergency tickets are good for 20 calendar days (from July 1, 2025).

MS.renew: Update at least 3 working days before it expires (the law’s window: 3 to 4 working days before).
MS.tol_text: 18 inches from each side of the marks, plus half the diameter if shown.
MS.white_text: Pre-mark the area unless it is electronically pre-marked.
MS.emergency: Operators respond to emergency tickets within 2 hours.

trench.text: Federal OSHA covers private crews here: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

MS.note: We could not confirm Mississippi’s wait before digging. Check Mississippi 811.

sources.what: Miss. Code 77-13-5 (renew 3 to 4 working days before; text current to Jan 2025)

NV.name: Nevada

notice.text: Call at least 2 working days (7 AM to 5 PM, not holidays) and not more than 28 calendar days before digging.

start.text: Call no more than 28 calendar days before work starts.

life.text: A ticket is good for 28 calendar days from the day it is issued.

NV.renew: Renew by the end of day 28 if work goes on and marks are still clear. Two renewals at most (84 days), then a new ticket: call it in at least 2 working days before the last renewal runs out. You can keep digging on the old ticket until it runs out.
NV.tol_text: The facility can be up to 24 inches either side. Hand tools only within 24 inches.
NV.white_text: Mark the proposed dig area (white paint, flags, stakes or whiskers).
NV.emergency: In an emergency you may dig without the wait. Tell the operator as soon as you can.

trench.text: Nevada OSHA enforces the federal rule: protective system from 5 ft (29 CFR 1926.652).

sources.what: NAC 455.165 (28 days, two extensions, then a new notification)
NRS 455 (24 in approximate location, working day)
USA North 811 Nevada 2025 handbook (28 days, 2 renewals)
Nevada OSHA letter: enforces 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P

MD.name: Maryland

notice.text: Pick a start date at least 3 and not more than 12 business days after the ticket.

start.text: The start date can be no more than 12 business days after the ticket.

life.text: A ticket is good for 12 business days after the start date you picked. The app counts from the first legal dig day.

MD.renew: Repeat the notice before the 12 business days run out.
MD.tol_text: Marks within 18 inches either side. No power equipment within 18 inches of the marks.
MD.white_text: Miss Utility suggests marking the dig site in white.

trench.text: State OSHA plan. Federal OSHA’s 5 ft rule is the floor; we have not checked whether this plan is stricter.

MI.name: Michigan

notice.text: Give notice at least 72 hours (not counting non-business days) and not more than 14 calendar days before digging.

start.text: Give notice no more than 14 calendar days before work starts.

life.text: A ticket is good for 21 days from the start date (180 days if the notice says the work will take longer). The app counts from the first legal dig day.

MI.renew: Past 21 days, get a new ticket. Long jobs: ask MISS DIG 811 for a 180-day ticket.
MI.tol_text: Caution zone: 48 inches either side of the marks. Expose marked lines by soft digging.
MI.white_text: White-line before the ticket when the parcel can’t be described.
MI.emergency: Give prompt emergency notice. Do only the work the emergency needs.

trench.text: State OSHA plan. Federal OSHA’s 5 ft rule is the floor; we have not checked whether this plan is stricter.

IA.name: Iowa

notice.text: Give notice so digging starts after a 48-hour period.

life.text: A notice is good for 25 calendar days starting the day the 48 hours end.

IA.renew: Past 25 days, request a new ticket.
IA.tol_text: The facility location includes 18 inches either side.
IA.white_text: Mark the proposed area with white paint, flags or stakes unless an exception applies.
IA.emergency: Emergency: you may start right away. Notify Iowa One Call as soon as practical.

trench.text: State OSHA plan. Federal OSHA’s 5 ft rule is the floor; we have not checked whether this plan is stricter.
